topic: Change of Basis in Linear Algebra

sections.title: The Concept of 'Perspective' (Prerequisite Review)
lecture_lines: Space is the same; coordinate descriptions differ.
Imagine a point viewed through different rulers.
Standard grid lines define our default perspective.
Switching basis changes the coordinate numbers.
The vector stays put; labels just shift.
animations: 1. Fade in text: 'Space constant, perspective varies' in #FFFFFF.
2. Show a 2D plane with two different colored grids (A: #3498DB, B: #E74C3C).
3. Display a fixed vector 'v' in #F1C40F against both grid systems, alongside a [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/ruler.svg] to indicate spatial measurement.
4. Animate labels 'v_A' and 'v_B' appearing near their respective coordinate systems.
5. Flash both labels to emphasize that the vector remains stationary.

sections.title: The Transition Matrix (The Bridge)
lecture_lines: We need a translator between bases.
The change of basis matrix bridges systems.
Matrix multiplication maps coordinates across perspectives.
animations: 1. Display matrix label 'T' in #FFFFFF as the transformation bridge [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/bridge.svg].
2. Represent two bases as colored vectors (Basis 1: #3498DB, Basis 2: #E74C3C).
3. Draw directional arrows from Basis 1 vectors pointing into the transformation grid to show mapping.

sections.title: Deriving the Calculation Process
lecture_lines: Equation: the vector in A equals P times B.
Matrix P columns are basis vectors in A.
Basis vectors serve as the transformation's building blocks.
animations: 1. Write the equation 'v_A = P * v_B' in #FFFFFF.
2. Highlight the matrix 'P' using a [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/block.svg] in #F1C40F, denoting it as the change-of-basis operator.
3. Animate column vectors of 'P' using [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/brick.svg] to highlight one by one and show them as the transformed basis.

sections.title: Practical Application & Summary
lecture_lines: Choosing a smart basis simplifies complex motion.
Rotation is just scaling in the right basis.
Change of basis reveals the simplest perspective.
animations: 1. Display text '#FFFFFF': 'Smart basis choice simplifies motion'.
2. Show a rotating gear [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/gear.svg] spinning smoothly.
3. Highlight a diagonal matrix in #2ECC71 overlaid on the gear [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/gear.svg] to show rotation as simple scaling.
